scope: SOURCE/REVIEW PREREQUISITE ONLY, no installation or promotion

decisions.question: How to prevent old source rearm after generation2 target promotion, since current runtime ignores global floor/owner?
decisions.decision: Root-owned persistent guard outside queue on both nodes, carrying epoch,primary_host,operation_id,coordinator_boot_id. Bind worker claims/manifests to host/boot/opID/epoch digest; read guard before every mutation. Reboot invalidates rearm until new approved operation.
decisions.authority: Infra explicit native reply during this preparation
decisions.limitations: Materialized execution guard, not consensus/election; qualified distribution and fencing old source required before promotion.

decisions.question: One exact shared guard path and schema, compatible with Infra worker contract633?
decisions.decision: /etc/peticao-dev-authority/epoch.json; parentroot0755/file root0644. Exact generation(integer),primary_host(logical node civo),coordinator_boot_id(actual Civo boot UUID),operation_id(32hex canonical operation). Same SHA256 canonical sorted compact JSON as633; no extra epoch/schema/status fields in guard. Node ID civo is distinct from OS hostname peticao-civo. Root-owned nonwritable ancestry and singlelink; service read-only.
decisions.authority: Infra explicit native candidate accepted by Apoio for Root review; not installation authorization
